help.port: Tap a dock tab to inspect the ship, then tap its labelled service action. Tap BROWSE WRECKS to plan a run.
help.selection: Tap a wreck card to select it. Tap PREPARATION for optional route, crew, intel, and coverage changes, then tap DEPART.
help.travel: Tap ARRIVE or CONTINUE to enter the wreck. On the homebound leg, tap DOCK NOW to resolve returned cargo.
help.salvage: Tap SCAN, tap a revealed bracket, choose its transfer command, then tap a hold cell. Tap RETURN WITH HAUL when finished.
help.inventory: Tap a cargo row action or a hold cell to rearrange cargo. Keep pending items placed or tap LEAVE UNPLACED before returning.
help.results: Tap SELL, INSTALL, or BREAK DOWN on each returned item. VOYAGE DETAILS opens the filed recovery record.

scan_hint: Tap SCAN, then tap an object inside the wreck.
select_hint: Tap a bracketed object, choose its transfer command, then choose where it fits in the hold.
choose_destination: Choose a hold position before starting the pull.
placement_hint: Tap a cell to place the top-left corner and begin the pull. ROTATE changes the footprint. Red means it will not fit.
hold_full: No internal cargo berth is free. Review the hold before pulling another item.
clamps_full: No external clamp is free. Review the hold before pulling another item.
transfer_busy: Finish or cancel the active pull first.
transfer_complete: secured in the chosen hold position.

inventory_copy.empty_hint: Recovered items appear here after pickup.
inventory_copy.move_hint: Tap MOVE, then choose a grid cell.
inventory_copy.placing_hint: Choose a grid cell for the selected item.
inventory_copy.pending_hint: Place or leave unplaced cargo before returning.
